prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.399 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.5 °C (within 1% of healthy). Operating temperatures and thermal gradient remain within optimal baseline specifications.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.98 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.36 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 403 W·min/l (5% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 54.8 % (7% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.6 bar (within 2% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
